headline: Amazon Bedrock introduces granular cost tracking and model distillation improvements for efficient AI deployment.

items.title: Introducing granular cost attribution for Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock has launched granular cost attribution capabilities that allow users to track and allocate costs more precisely across different projects or teams using their AI services. This feature enables users to view detailed cost breakdowns, helping in optimizing resource usage and budgeting for AI deployments. This update is expected to improve financial management and accountability in organizations leveraging Bedrock for machine learning operations.
items.why_it_matters: Precise cost management is crucial for tech leads to optimize AI resource allocation and budget effectively.

items.title: Optimize video semantic search intent with Amazon Nova Model Distillation on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Amazon has introduced a model customization technique called Model Distillation on Amazon Bedrock, which enables transferring knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student model. This process significantly reduces inference costs by over 95% while maintaining performance, making it an attractive solution for cost-effective AI deployments.

items.title: Nova Forge SDK series part 2: Practical guide to fine-tune Nova models using data mixing capabilities
items.summary: Amazon has released a guide on using the Nova Forge SDK for fine-tuning Nova models through data mixing techniques. This comprehensive guide covers data preparation, training, and evaluation, providing a repeatable process for customizing models to specific use cases.

items.title: Building a Fast Multilingual OCR Model with Synthetic Data
items.summary: Hugging Face, in collaboration with NVIDIA, has developed a fast multilingual OCR model using synthetic data, enabling efficient text recognition across multiple languages. This advancement leverages synthetic data generation to improve model accuracy and decrease training time, providing a scalable solution for multilingual OCR needs.

all_items.title: Optimize video semantic search intent with Amazon Nova Model Distillation on Amazon Bedrock
all_items.summary: In this post, we show you how to use Model Distillation, a model customization technique on Amazon Bedrock, to transfer routing intelligence from a large teacher model (Amazon Nova Premier) into a much smaller student model (Amazon Nova Micro). This approach cuts inference cost by over 95% and reduces latency by 50% while maintaining the nuanced routing quality that the task demands.

all_items.title: Power video semantic search with Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings
all_items.summary: In this post, we show you how to build a video semantic search solution on Amazon Bedrock using Nova Multimodal Embeddings that intelligently understands user intent and retrieves accurate video results across all signal types simultaneously. We also share a reference implementation you can deploy and explore with your own content.

all_items.title: Nova Forge SDK series part 2: Practical guide to fine-tune Nova models using data mixing capabilities

This is the second part in our Nova Forge SDK series, building on the SDK introduction and first part, which covered kicking off customization experiments.
